old-vs-new checker on one dist: 72 budget variants (each route js-1, js=budget, css-1, unbudgeted; ghost route) x baseline present/absent = 144 of 144 identical exit code and failure lines (scratch harness, not committed); also clean 569f4bb build old rc 0 == new rc 0
deviations_from_card: package.json unchanged: the existing budget:bundle script already forwards --write-baseline, so the documented refresh command is `pnpm -C apps/console build && pnpm -C apps/console budget:bundle --write-baseline` (in check-bundle.mjs header, the baseline's $comment and the no-baseline hint). Synthetic hashes in tests are 8 chars (vite's real length; chunkKey matches exactly -[\w-]{8}, which also handles hashes containing '-', e.g. _StatBand-1bNxvU-n.js) instead of the card's AAAA shorthand. Same-stem collision naming: _index~1.js/_index~2.js ordered by hash-free importer list then key, stable under rehash (tested). Red-before was an import failure (module absent), not an assertion, so tests and implementation landed as one commit. budgets/bundle.json not edited.
notes: bundle.measured.json was measured from a clean `git archive` export of 569f4bb (node_modules junctioned) so siblings' uncommitted work is not in it; at the time of commit the shared-tree build shows deltas (e.g. characters.l2 +3806 B, onair.l1 +1620 B) that are siblings' in-flight bytes. Coordinator: after the wave lands, refresh with the command above and commit the baseline. Gates were red mid-run only on siblings' in-flight files (onair/view.test.ts, characters layer2.test.tsx size, config.test.ts); final rerun all 0. One build hit exit 2 (manifest missing) from a concurrent sibling build emptying dist; rerun was 0.
